target: For every prime p, natural s,M with M>2s, e solved coordinates and k parameter coordinates, F,H in Z_p[Y,T]^e and a=(y0,t0) an exact root of F, let J=D_Y F(a), K=D_T F(a). Assume J invertible over Q_p and p^s J^{-1} integral. For every v in Z_p^k prescribe tau=t0+p^M v and G=F+p^M H. Construct the unique y in y0+p^(s+1) Z_p^e satisfying G(y,tau)=0. Prove y-y0 in p^(M-s) Z_p^e and y-y0=-p^M J^{-1}(H(a)+K v)+epsilon with integral epsilon in p^(2M-3s) Z_p^e. No assumption on the perturbed Jacobian; retain the same exponent s. Arbitrary p-adic coefficients and centers, all primes including 2, and zero finite dimensions.
